description: This file defines the ClassHelper class within the OrangeHRM system, providing utility methods to check class existence, retrieve class names with fallback namespaces, and verify interface implementations.

classes.name: ClassHelper
classes.description: Utility helper class for class existence, namespace resolution, and interface implementation checks.

methods.name: classExists
methods.description: Checks if a class exists, optionally using a fallback namespace.

methods.name: getClass
methods.description: Retrieves the fully qualified class name, trying the fallback namespace if necessary.

methods.name: hasClassImplements
methods.description: Checks if a class or object implements all specified interfaces.
